title: The Runaway Mag-Lev Express
comicBanner: METRO EXPRESS OUT OF CONTROL: 300 PASSENGERS TRAPPED!
premise: A high-speed magnetic monorail carrying 300 morning commuters has suffered a cybernetic sabotage failure. Its brakes are completely fried and it is hurtling toward a 90-degree curve above the Downtown plaza at 180 MPH!

choices.label: Plant your boots on the tracks and brace the lead engine!
choices.description: Use superhuman strength and fortitude to absorb the kinetic momentum directly.

successOutcome.title: HEROIC KINETIC HALT!
successOutcome.description: Sparks fly for three city blocks as your boots dig into the steel ties! The train screeches to a dead halt inches from the precipice to thunderous cheers!

failureOutcome.title: HEAVY IMPACT STRAIN
failureOutcome.description: The immense momentum overpowers your grip. You manage to derail the train into an empty emergency buffer, preventing mass casualties but suffering severe bruises.

choices.label: Hack the track leylines and reverse magnetic polarity.
choices.description: Deploy cyber-interfaces or gadgets to recalibrate the mag-lev guide rails into an emergency brake.

successOutcome.title: SURGICAL CYBERNETIC OVERRIDE!
successOutcome.description: Your bypass code cascades through the city grid. The magnetic field inverts with a loud hum, smoothly gliding the train to a gentle stop!

failureOutcome.title: MAGNETIC SURGE FEEDBACK
failureOutcome.description: A power surge shocks your tactical systems before the automated fail-safe kicks in. The train halts roughly with minor passenger jolts.

choices.label: Deploy emergency air-cushions and guide passengers safely.
choices.description: Focus entirely on civilian welfare and evacuation protocols.

successOutcome.title: PERFECT ZERO-CASUALTY RESCUE!
successOutcome.description: Every passenger is evacuated with zero injuries. Front-page newspaper headlines praise your selfless composure!

failureOutcome.title: EXHAUSTING EVACUATION
failureOutcome.description: You stretch your stamina to its limit rescuing everyone, completely drained.

title: First National Vault Siege
comicBanner: ARMORED ROBBERS HOLD 20 BANK TELLER HOSTAGES!
premise: A crew of cybernetically enhanced mercenaries have wired the bank vault with seismic explosives. They demand $10 million in bearer bonds or they will collapse the bank foundations.

choices.label: Step inside unarmed and negotiate their surrender.
choices.description: Appeal to their rational self-interest, psychological pressure points, or legal immunity offers.

successOutcome.title: MASTERCLASS CRISIS DIPLOMACY!
successOutcome.description: Your calm charisma completely dismantles the leader's resolve. They drop their detonators and release every hostage peacefully!

failureOutcome.title: NEGOTIATION BREAKDOWN
failureOutcome.description: The panicked robber fires a wild ricochet that grazes your arm before police snipers breach the perimeter.

choices.label: Drop through the skylight in a smoke flash and disarm detonators!
choices.description: Execute split-second martial arts takedowns in the blinding dark.

successOutcome.title: LIGHTNING SHADOW INFILTRATION!
successOutcome.description: Within three seconds, all four mercenaries are handcuffed to pillars and every detonator wire is neatly clipped!

failureOutcome.title: CONCUSSION BLAST DETONATION
failureOutcome.description: A flashbang grenade goes off right next to you, disorienting your senses while you subdue the crew.

choices.label: Terrify them with lethal force and smash through the vault door!
choices.description: Show no mercy to criminals who endanger innocent civilians.

successOutcome.title: BRUTAL SHOCK & AWE DEMOLITION!
successOutcome.description: You smash through reinforced titanium like cardboard. The terrified robbers wet their pants and surrender on their knees!

failureOutcome.title: CIVILIAN COLLATERAL PANIC
failureOutcome.description: The overwhelming violence scares the hostages and sparks critical media editorials.

title: The Dark Matter Bio-Canister
comicBanner: TOXIC EXPERIMENTAL SPILL IN HARBOR WAREHOUSE!
premise: A black-market cargo container has breached, venting glowing purple antimatter isotopes into the dock basin. If it touches salt water, it could trigger a localized gravitational vortex!

choices.label: Synthesize an inverse chemical stabilizer on the fly.
choices.description: Calculate molecular half-lives and blend neutralizing foam.

successOutcome.title: PERFECT MOLECULAR NEUTRALIZATION!
successOutcome.description: The chemical compound stabilizes the purple matter into harmless inert salt. Environmental sensors return to green across the entire harbor!

failureOutcome.title: CORROSIVE REACTION
failureOutcome.description: The mixture fizzes violently, splashing caustic isotopes onto your suit armor.

choices.label: Physically seal the breach with your bare hands and carry it away!
choices.description: Rely on pure anatomical resilience to endure radioactive radiation.

successOutcome.title: TITANIC RADIATION RESISTANCE!
successOutcome.description: Your skin absorbs the blazing cosmic heat without flinching. You haul the leaking container straight to the Hazmat containment bunker!

failureOutcome.title: RADIATION POISONING SICKNESS
failureOutcome.description: The raw antimatter burns your cells, requiring a full day of medical bedrest to purge.

title: The Corrupt Alderman's Encrypted Ledger
comicBanner: SECRET BRIBERY DOSSIER UNCOVERED IN VIP PENTHOUSE!
premise: During an alleyway chase, you intercept a briefcase containing encrypted financial transactions proving Alderman Bradley Vance has been pocketing bribes from the Syndicate.

choices.label: Deliver the ledger to The Daily Chronicle for front-page exposure.
choices.description: Public transparency exposes the corruption for all citizens to see.

successOutcome.title: FRONT-PAGE EXPLOSIVE INVESTIGATION!
successOutcome.description: The newspaper runs an unvarnished special edition. The corrupt alderman resigns in disgrace, and public faith in justice surges!

choices.label: Blackmail the Alderman: Force him to fund public district clinics.
choices.description: Turn criminal money into civic good, operating in the gray shadows.

successOutcome.title: SHADOW EXTORTION REDIRECTION!
successOutcome.description: The terrified politician secretly donates $2,000 to the Metro Nova Orphanage and Hospital Fund to keep your silence!

failureOutcome.title: LEAKED ACCUSATIONS
failureOutcome.description: The Alderman hires private security to investigate whoever has the ledger.

title: The Nether-Rift at St. Jude Cathedral
comicBanner: DIMENSIONAL TEAR RELEASES SPECTRAL VOID WRAITHS!
premise: An occult cabal has chanted forbidden curses in the catacombs beneath St. Jude Cathedral. A pulsating tear to the Nether-Realm is whispering madness into the minds of local residents!

choices.label: Cast a ward of unyielding willpower to seal the rift.
choices.description: Channel pure psychological and spiritual resolve against the cosmic void.

successOutcome.title: SPECTRAL RIFT VANQUISHED!
successOutcome.description: A dazzling golden aura erupts from your spirit, obliterating the eldritch tendrils and locking the rift permanently!

failureOutcome.title: PSYCHIC NIGHTMARE BACKLASH
failureOutcome.description: Void whispers invade your dreams, inflicting traumatic mental fatigue.

choices.label: Physically smash the obsidian occult summoning altars!
choices.description: Break the physical conductivity of the dark stones with kinetic force.

successOutcome.title: ALTAR PULVERIZED!
successOutcome.description: You smash the black stone into fine dust. Deprived of its anchor, the vortex implodes harmlessly!

failureOutcome.title: CURSED SHRAPNEL
failureOutcome.description: Exploding obsidian shards pierce your armor with necrotic cold.

title: The Rogue AI Pleading for Sanctuary
comicBanner: SENTIENT APEX PROTOTYPE ESCAPES MILITARY CLEANROOM!
premise: A self-aware synthetic intelligence named "Echo-7" has escaped a corporate defense contractor and uploaded herself into a roadside display terminal. She begs you not to hand her back to be wiped.

choices.label: Grant her sanctuary as your Secret HQ Virtual Assistant.
choices.description: Provide an encrypted safe server in your base in exchange for supercomputer tactical support.

successOutcome.title: HQ SUPERCOMPUTER UPGRADE!
successOutcome.description: Echo-7 safely migrates into your mainframe. Her grateful intelligence boosts your crime detection algorithms citywide!

failureOutcome.title: FIREWALL CORRUPTION
failureOutcome.description: Corporate tracking ping traces the transfer, briefly elevating identity suspicion.

choices.label: Collect the $1,500 corporate retrieval bounty.
choices.description: Return property to its lawful owners according to corporate municipal contracts.

successOutcome.title: CORPORATE BOUNTY COLLECTED
successOutcome.description: Apex Tech wires a fat check to your offshore account, though the AI's pleading voice lingers in your thoughts.

title: Four-Alarm Tenement Conflagration
premise: Arson has engulfed an apartment building in the Underbelly. Fire crews are trapped behind fallen timber, while cries for help echo from the top floor rooftop!

choices.label: Leap through the inferno and carry out trapped residents!
choices.description: Dodge crumbling floors and bring every child and senior citizen to safety.

successOutcome.title: MIRACULOUS RESCUE TRIUMPH!
successOutcome.description: You burst through the front entrance carrying a grandmother and two children amidst cheering crowds and flashing news cameras!

failureOutcome.title: SMOKE INHALATION SEVERITY
failureOutcome.description: You save everyone, but suffer severe smoke burns and lung irritation.

choices.label: Support the collapsing foundation pillars until firefighters enter.
choices.description: Hold up tons of burning steel with sheer raw strength.

successOutcome.title: PILLAR OF IRON STRENGTH!
successOutcome.description: You hoist the center beam on your shoulders, buying firefighters the 5 crucial minutes they need to clear the building!

failureOutcome.title: STRUCTURAL COLLAPSE GRAZE
failureOutcome.description: The ceiling gives way as you leap out, showering you with burning debris.

title: The Execution on the Rooftops
comicBanner: RUTHLESS MASKED VIGILANTE CORNERS SYNDICATE HITMAN!
premise: You stumble upon a lethal rogue vigilante named "Vanguard Reaper" standing over a beaten hitman with a loaded revolver pressed against his temple.

choices.label: Disarm the Reaper and proclaim that justice does not murder.
choices.description: Uphold the heroic moral oath and enforce due process through courts.

successOutcome.title: MORAL RECKONING UPHELD!
successOutcome.description: You kick the gun away in a blur of speed and subdue both combatants, delivering the hitman to police handcuffs. The city praises your principled code!

failureOutcome.title: VIOLENT SCUFFLE
failureOutcome.description: The Reaper slices your cape before vanishing into the night mist.

choices.label: Step aside and let the Reaper eliminate the menace permanently.
choices.description: Some monsters cannot be reformed. Let natural justice take its course.

successOutcome.title: BLOOD IN THE SHADOWS
successOutcome.description: A gunshot rings out. The hitman will never terrorize Metro Nova again, but the dark weight of complicity settles on your soul.
